message.content:
1. Visible sections: Customer testimonials, "Styled by our community" (UGC/social proof), Newsletter signup ("Stay in the Loop"), Footer (brand info, shop/support links, contact, payment methods).  
2. Product/category images (UGC thumbnails) load correctly—no broken/empty placeholders.  
3. Layout is balanced: Content blocks (testimonials, UGC, newsletter, footer) are well-sized, not overly narrow or stretched.  
4. Gold/black premium aesthetic is consistent: Dark background, gold accents (text/buttons), cohesive typography.  
5. No visual defects: No overlapping elements, broken layout, missing text, white voids, or misaligned content.
